{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Canyon Gathering System''' is a proposed natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.enbridge.com/media-center/news/details?id=123829|title=enbridge.com|website=enbridge.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Keathley Canyon Block 293 to Tie-in to Magnolia Gas Gathering Pipeline.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.offshore-mag.com/regional-reports/us-gulf-of-mexico/news/55233339/enbridge-inc-enbridge-sanctions-new-offshore-pipelines-to-support-bps-kaskida-development|title=offshore-mag.com|website=offshore-mag.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.enbridge.com/media-center/news/details?id=123829|title=enbridge.com|website=enbridge.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
*'''Owner: '''Enbridge Inc<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.enbridge.com/media-center/news/details?id=123829|title=enbridge.com|website=enbridge.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''125 MMcf/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.enbridge.com/media-center/news/details?id=123829|title=enbridge.com|website=enbridge.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''60 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.offshore-mag.com/regional-reports/us-gulf-of-mexico/news/55233339/enbridge-inc-enbridge-sanctions-new-offshore-pipelines-to-support-bps-kaskida-development|title=offshore-mag.com|website=offshore-mag.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''12 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.enbridge.com/media-center/news/details?id=123829|title=enbridge.com|website=enbridge.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Proposed<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.enbridge.com/media-center/news/details?id=123829|title=enbridge.com|website=enbridge.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Proposal year: '''2024<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.enbridge.com/media-center/news/details?id=123829|title=enbridge.com|website=enbridge.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
